prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a square editorial cover illustration for a custom remote service connection in Factory's MCP library.
Input image 1 is a style reference only. Keep its reductive woodcut and cut-paper character, subtle ink-on-paper texture, bold silhouettes and considered negative space. Do not copy its branching-path composition.
Primary request: two thick dark blue-green cables curve into the composition from opposite edges, their complementary substantial plug and socket joined at the center. A clear interlocking connector sleeve in straw ochre makes the connection legible. One cable makes a broad loop above the join and the other curves below it. Confident close-up, large tactile shapes, asymmetrical negative space. No tiny central app icon.
Color palette: warm chalk ground, deep blue-green cables and straw ochre connector sleeve, with restrained river-blue ink. Full-bleed carved ink print, no surrounding frame. Same small-press cover family as the reference.
Canvas: square, edge-to-edge artwork. Keep the joined connector within the central three quarters of the width so a portrait crop retains it.
Constraints: no words, letters, labels, logos, symbols, checks, status lights, UI, screens, books, people, arrows, fake code, gradients or drop shadows. This is an illustration of connectivity, not a factual account status.
